name: Maher Shalal Hash Baz
overview: Maher Shalal Hash Baz is a symbolic name given by the LORD to Isaiah's son, representing the swift coming judgment on Damascus and Samaria. The name, meaning 'speed to the spoil, hasten the prey,' signifies the imminent capture of these riches by the king of Assyria, even before the child can speak. This prophetic sign underscores God's sovereign control over history and His judgment against Israel's enemies, as recorded with faithful witnesses to confirm its certainty.
